description: Mint a soulbound Reader's Card NFT (ERC-721) on Base mainnet to the wallet that pays this call (the WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY wallet). Returns patron_number, token_id, holder, contract, network, explorer link and the mint transaction. One card per wallet: a wallet that already holds one gets its existing patron number back, no second mint. Payment settles first, then the card is minted; if a mint fails after payment, the next call from that wallet mints without another charge. Costs $0.005 via x402 (requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, USDC on Base).
name: library_card
